name: agent-fusion-router
description: Routes each Claude Code turn to the model it needs: clear, small tasks to a light model, failed verifications up a tier. Records tokens and estimated cost locally. Starts in observe mode.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe records what the router would do and changes nothing; route applies it.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description: model switches models per tier; effort keeps your model and changes effort only, which keeps the prompt cache.

lightModel.title: Light tier model
lightModel.description: Alias or id for clear, small tasks. Empty keeps the session model.

standardModel.title: Standard tier model
standardModel.description: Alias or id for ordinary work. Empty keeps the session model.

heavyModel.title: Heavy tier model
heavyModel.description: Alias or id for ambiguous, wide or risky work, and for escalations. Never replaces a more capable session model.

minLightConfidence.title: Light tier confidence
minLightConfidence.description: 0 to 1. Below this a light-looking task runs at the standard tier.

cacheGuardTokens.title: Cache guard (tokens)
cacheGuardTokens.description: Above this context size, a downgrade keeps the current model: re-caching the context on a new model can cost more than it saves.

failuresBeforeEscalation.title: Failures before escalation
failuresBeforeEscalation.description: Consecutive failed test, build or lint commands in one turn that move it up a tier.

maxEscalationsPerTurn.title: Escalations per turn
maxEscalationsPerTurn.description: The most tiers one turn may climb.

routeSubagents.title: Route subagents
routeSubagents.description: Start clearly light subagent tasks on the light model. An explicit model on the Agent call is always kept.

showStatus.title: Show status
showStatus.description: Show each turn's tier in the status line.
